2119183863381369331.en_summary: Arista $ANET CEO Jayshree Ullal forecasts greater than 10 gigawatts of deployment across 10 or more different types of compute accelerators by the end of 2027. Mentions $NVDA $AMD $AVGO.
2119183863381369331.zh_summary: Arista $ANET 首席執行官 Jayshree Ullal 預測，到 2027 年底，跨 10 種或更多不同類型計算加速器的部署將超過 10 吉瓦。提及 $NVDA $AMD $AVGO。

2119181095438798902.en_summary: Oracle $ORCL has seen the sharpest growth among hyperscalers in quarterly capex over the past five years, up 2,540% to $28.5 billion, followed by Alphabet $GOOG with a 705% increase to $51.4 billion. Mentions $AMZN $MSFT $META.
2119181095438798902.zh_summary: Oracle $ORCL 在過去五年中超大規模業者季度資本支出增長最為迅猛，增長 2,540% 至 285 億美元，其次是 Alphabet $GOOG 增長 705% 至 514 億美元。提及 $AMZN $MSFT $META。

2119175009285648507.en_summary: @Jake__Wujastyk says $GLD gold looks intriguing for the first time in a while.
2119175009285648507.zh_summary: @Jake__Wujastyk 表示，$GLD 黃金一段時間以來首次看起來有趣。

2119173048263926024.en_summary: $CAT Caterpillar CEO says data-center power demand is extending the equipment order book into 2029 and 2030. Backlog continues to grow due to strong order rates, taking large reciprocating orders as far out as 2029 and turbine orders into 2030.
2119173048263926024.zh_summary: $CAT Caterpillar 首席執行官表示，數據中心電力需求將設備訂單簿延伸至 2029 和 2030 年。由於強勁訂單率，積壓訂單持續增長，正在接受遠至 2029 年的大型往復式訂單以及 2030 年的渦輪機訂單。

2119172543361773713.en_summary: @Beth_Kindig notes that although air-cooled options exist for latest GPUs such as $NVDA Blackwell Ultra, liquid cooling is a necessity to maximize data center density. Liquid cooling adoption is forecast to accelerate sharply in 2026 and further in 2027, driven by Blackwell Ultra ramp and upcoming Rubin and $AMD Helios. Mentions $DELL $SMCI.
2119172543361773713.zh_summary: @Beth_Kindig 指出，儘管最新 GPU 如 $NVDA Blackwell Ultra 仍有風冷選項，但液冷是最大化數據中心密度的必要條件。液冷採用預計在 2026 年大幅加速，並在 2027 年進一步加速，由 Blackwell Ultra 爬坡以及即將推出的 Rubin 和 $AMD Helios 驅動。提及 $DELL $SMCI。
